note: Filtered sample: the 6,169 newest written reviews (2026-07-15 to 2026-11-02) were read through the Play Store's own review data in the built-in browser; only the 58 that contain a family or caregiving word (mom, dad, parent, husband, wife, spouse, grandma, grandpa, caregiver, elderly, loved one, family member, proxy, and similar) are saved here. Reviewer names omitted. Not a random sample.

reviews.text: This app has been incredibly advantageous helping me corresponding with my elderly Father's care team. THANK YOU!
Great app for test results and talking with your doctor. Difficult for the parent to get the app started for a minor.

Not long uploaded this App. Finding it good but the History hasn't been loaded very far back which is disappointing otherwise good. Like the fact you can sgare with family members as my husband is unable to downloads app as his mobiles too old!

I use the app when needed, and for people with smart phones, it certainly seems to do what Is needed and is pretty useful. My parents who have refused to get on board with the smart phone brigade, mainly because of their technological fears will hopefully still be catered for in the old school manner...?? But for me and those who are up to date with technology this is a solid app and so far, works very well.. 😁

Excellent app allowing parents to keep in touch with GOSH specialists doctors whenever necessary. Communication is being received through the app, also any visits to hospital and tests results are being confirmed in the app.
my wife can never get on my chart. She has to change the password everytime. ridiculous site.
will not add my wife to see or pay my bill

As an Aramco employee and a father of a daughter with Down syndrome, I am extremely disappointed with Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare (JHAH). My daughter has not received proper physiotherapy follow-up, developmental support, or clear guidance about her medical rights and available benefits. I love having access to my records, test results, and upcoming tests needed. However, I don't like that old tests ordered and past reminders for doctor appointments, labs, and xrays/CT's pop up with the new orders under the update section. It seems that these completed tests should only show under results or, atthe very least, have the date visible upfront. This could be very confusing for more elderly patients.

this app allowed me to see the actual treatment to my husband while he was hospitalized. It gave me comfort to know day to day his treatment, and his medications. Is user friendly and easy to use. Use this app.

I found this app immediately useful and intuitive. All of the most important features are front and center. historical info is saved , so it's easy to compared annual test results, etc. Note that it appears that different institutions assign different "skins" which can be very different. I am a University Hospitals patient and my version is outstanding. My spouse is a Cleveland Clinic patient and his version is much more difficult to use. Not sure why that is.

outrageously complex and difficult to add my minor to my account. I, as a mom, should be allowed access to my child's medical records and not be told to go to the office and create a "teen account". my child is barely 14 and it is my responsibility to have that information.
Didn't want to do it at first, but now can't live without. Keeps me and my wife's medical appointments organized. We can review our test results. We love 😘 My Chart.
very difficult and complicated9 Not At All User Friendly Think about an Elderly or Handicapped. The App.designer needs to Have a Proper Training Needs to go to the Computer Training School.
thanking for being elder grandma friendly

My children said come to the 21st century father and get this app to help you with appointments and organization and your complete lack of memory!!?? lol well hot damn. they were right! easy to use and look at my tests and labs and appts. can contact my various doctors who help keep me moving and active this app has my 100% approval. stay tuned for more...
All the Dr's, Nurses and and Health Care Workers were Very Respectful and treated me like a Family member, The Best Hospital in Chicago. I Recommend to All My Family and Friend's 💯
easy to keep all dr records in one app its kool as heck....get the app is promise its worth it .its free and parents its so useful especially foe someone with lots of medical problems.

omg i love this app ,as my mom moved to Mississippi i can no longer get up and run when she is ill she was diagnosed with cancer for the 3rd time but this time shes in Mississippi and this mychart keeps me up to date on everything and helps my stress levels so much no waiting for a fon call or sitting on hold for 30 mins to to see what's going on i love this app
Sarah is great Dr with my mom

Me and my mom have been using this app since I was 13 yrs old, you see have been diagnosed with Lupus & this app us stay connected with my doctors. This app helps keep track of my appointments, medicine refills, and my medical test results. Me and my family get a full update about everything.
easy to use with all my important reminders and medical information in one place. proxy access helps me with managing appointments for dependents' too.
This app is vital for keeping up with my mom's office visits and medication. The most amazing thing is it allows me to communicate with my mom's doctor and he always replies the same day.
Getting harder to go to for elderly people.
my wife's account appears to be locked out, and there are no instructions on getting it unlocked. Apparently, no customer support.
I love this app because I can keep track of my mom's progress while she's in the hospital.
cannot create account for my husband. he doesn't have a mobile phone.
Absolutely love MyChart!! sometimes it takes a bit to get back to me because I don't drive and am needing something from Dr. Amy's office my husband can grab on his way to work this morning
My experience is new. I don't have a key or lock. I'm just wanting to assist my father clear his debts. It's taking longer than anticipated because my hands are full.
The app works quite well but I think that the area where you insert your pin should have larger numbers so as to make it easier for the elderly.
Love how easy it is to see appointments and to communicate with physicians, especially as a first time mom.
Option to use for both BILH and MGB is nice but it fails to work when using my husband's account to log in.

Very useful and practical app which allows you an oversight on all medication, treatment progress and lab results as well as make it easy to communicate with the healthcare team. It helped me a lot follow up on my mom's medical condition from outside the country.
Great app! honestly, it took me a long time to figure out how to really use it but once I did.. It's a wonderful resource. Not only for yourself, but if you're a parent. It's very useful.

I love how user friendly this app is. I am able to do self check in which for me is great. I love that I have all my family medical information in 1 place, instead of taking all our med to the Dr. appt, I can pull up the information. I would recommend using this app if you want to streamline all your family medical history specially if you have kids or grown parents.
can not sign into my wife's account after update. can sign into mine. impossible to work with tech people to get this resolved.

MyChart has been a huge assist for managing the multiple medical requirements of my 88 year young Mom. the ability to log in with my quick numeric code, capture screenshots and save files to share with my brothers and other caregivers is a very proactive and thoughtful tool. the interaction with Medical Teams ability to ask questions and review test results ASAP is truly forward thinking.
love this app I can keep up with my Drs appts and my husband's appts and everything about us it's Great

wouldn't go anywhere else, after the amazing care of the cardiac teams, my husband wouldn't be here if not for their skill and knowledge their are no words to describe these doctors Amazing!! our miracle team!

I love my chart it keeps up with all appointments and instructions medicine your dr can send you messages or you can send them one you can read results from test its so convenient and you can pay your bill check in at appointments and have that part done when you get there you can share information with all your different Doctors its all documented can't go wrong with this app I love it even if it is my husband's I'm sure when I start having dr trips I'll start one up on myself.

This is in reference to my dad's stay at Roper berkeley. Love the hospital and staff. The care they are giving him is above and beyond all other hospitals. The only issue im having is the VA where he has his home care are not allowed to open outside links on government phone so they can't view his progress. wish they could see what's going on with dad medicaly. But I do highly recommend this hospital.
is a really helpful tool for parents, I keep in touch whit my kids doctors tru de app and have everything I need . for example the record that are required for the school

everything in one place. appointments, test results, billing, and more. you can help take control of your own health. and for aging parents, you can get onto their information as a proxy to help manage their appointments and etc.
this app has been of paramount importance in tracking my wife's many appointments battling cancer.
very convenient especially when using to take care of yourself and a family member

MyChart is an important tool in advocating for yourself and your loved ones' health care. Excellent for tracking and planning ... I've used it for myself and family members for more than two years. It's a great resource for keeping up with appointments and results. I appreciate the ability to see trends in test results and to self-schedule many appointments. When a loved one is hospitalized, daily care notes are informative and comforting.

finally adding area you can pay bills too ( since 2022). Hopefully the same info will transfer to new app. especially seeing I'm a care giver and all the paperwork I already submitted to have access to whom I'm giving care. in otherworldly I hope we don't have to do it all over again with the updates and transition In Oct!!!

App needs to improve the user experience. For example, why do I always have to reenter the same information about my retirement? What's going to change. Why not carry my previous entry and ask to confirm? Same thing about my spouse. Carry the previous answers and ask to confirm or update if applicable? It's so frustrating to reenter information that is unlike to change over time. For God's sake, make the app a lot more friendly .... PLEASE!!!!

While using MyChart to schedule health screenings- my local hospital was not even listed and when I attempted to call the local hospital scheduling number it was routed to the parent organization that did not know the scheduling procedures for my local hospital.
works good for people that are tech savvy but for my grandpa he barely knows how to use it. Need to make it more easier for older people that are not tech savvy.

This app is super helpful in providing test results,keeping track of appointments and viewing doctors' notes . .Allows me to see both my husband's and my records with a single log in. Keeps track of billing and you can leave a message for the doctor in non emergency situations.
MyChart has been very handy when my wife or I have been in the hospital. It also provided history requested by my physician. Very handy for making certain payments.

I liked this app UNTIL it became important with a family member's hospitalization. 1. Test results should be able to be sorted by UPLOAD date,(when did provider send the results), test date, etc. 2. Getting a random notification that " you have a new test result" but not knowing which family member ( when 3 were at the doctor yesterday) stinks!!! Change this to " _________(name) has a new test result" 3. During an EXTENSIVE hospital stay, test results build up. Add a Mark All Read option.

my has been going to this place for treatment for few years now had a resent doctor's appointment with this new resident who wasn't firmer with my husband history he was not a good listener after we explained to him what was going on with him he seem not to care told him my husband had a sinus infection was informed go to the hospital refused to call in any of his refills to so we are in the process of looking into see if we have a case against this place for falling to prove care

Can't read anything, just get blank pages. when I could read the pages my messages were not getting received. I have Uninstalled and reinstalled with the same results. My wife's phone does the same thing. useless app update - app started working but I haven't tried all of it's features.

I appreciate having access to my medical records and my doctors, but the MyChart app is often frustrating to use. The billing support has been unhelpful and difficult to work with. I also don't understand why parents lose or have limited access to their child's records before they turn 18. If this is due to the law, the app should clearly explain it. If not, the process needs to be improved.

You really Suck disabling Screenshots!! When i need to share data with family and caregiver consultant, I can't !!!!... THERE-BY.. need to take picture of my screen with ANOTHER phone in order to capture my information. You it stupid to do as it is regardless what some one thinks they are accomplishing by disabling it. Whomever...needs Take this rediculous screenshot restriction off as we need to share our data with who ever we need and choose, without giving out my credentials!! FRediculous!!!
my wife and I have the same organizations in MyChart. it would be nice to be able to put multiple logins on the same organization. I have not figured out how to do that yet.
